note: Felles stil for alt som genereres (content/assets.json). Hvert bilde bestilles som: style.prompt + framing for sin type + beskrivelsen av motivet. Endres stilen, øk version: bilder laget med en eldre versjon kan da finnes og lages på nytt. Se content/README.md. Versjon 2 (eieren, 2026-10-31): 16-bit SNES-RPG pixel art, magi/fantasy/D&D, som konseptbildene i `references`.

style.about: 16-bit SNES-RPG pixel art, magi/fantasy/D&D, varm og vennlig, for barn 5–7 år. Figurene er søte (chibi) med store, vennlige øyne og detaljerte eventyrklær: kapper, belter, vesker, staver, lykter. Monstrene er rare og litt tøysete, aldri skumle. Alt skal kunne kjennes igjen i liten størrelse på en iPad.
style.prompt: 16-bit SNES-era JRPG pixel art, crisp chunky pixels with a clean dark outline, dithered shading and a small highlight, drawn at about 128 by 128 pixels and scaled up with hard pixel edges. Rich warm saturated palette: gold, amber, forest green, royal purple, slate blue, warm brown. Cute chibi proportions, big friendly expressive eyes, detailed fantasy adventure costume (cloaks, belts, pouches, staffs, lanterns). Whimsical, cosy Nordic fairy-tale mood, curious, never scary. Single subject, centred, fully visible, plain transparent background, no text, no letters, no frame, no border.
style.avoid: scary, gore, blood, sharp teeth close-up, horror, realistic photo, 3D render, smooth airbrushed gradients, blurry, anti-aliased, painterly, text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, busy background, multiple subjects, cropped subject

framing.figure: A full-body character, standing or sitting, facing the viewer slightly turned, like a JRPG character sprite drawn large.
framing.item: A single object, slightly from above, like a JRPG inventory icon drawn large.
framing.obstacle: A small scene of the obstacle in a dungeon passage of slate-blue stone blocks, seen from the front.
framing.source: A small scene of the place in a dungeon of slate-blue stone blocks, the source clearly visible.
framing.recipe: A single crafted object, slightly from above, like a JRPG inventory icon drawn large.
framing.tag: A very simple pixel icon for the idea, bold and flat, like a 16 by 16 game icon, readable at 32 pixels.
framing.mission: The goal of an adventure, shown as a single important thing or character.
framing.theme: A single thing or character, like a JRPG sprite drawn large.
framing.generic: A very simple pixel icon, bold and flat, like a 16 by 16 game icon, readable at 32 pixels.
framing.ui: A simple, friendly pixel icon for a child's game screen, bold and flat, with a dark outline, readable at 32 pixels, on a transparent background.
